english: Enter the 6-digit security code you received.
french: Entrez le code de sécurité à 6 chiffres que vous avez reçu.
note: CRITICAL / third mechanism: this is a JavaScript string literal inside the injected page-probe script. It becomes VerificationState.instruction and is rendered by Text(model.verificationState.instruction) (VerificationView.swift:97/110/264), which is the verbatim Text initializer. It can NEVER be localized by the Swift catalog. Fix: have the JS return a token (e.g. codeMethodKind) and build the sentence in Swift with Loc.text.

english: Enter your OmniVox password.

french: %@ est déjà sur cet appareil; inutile de l’ajouter de nouveau. Nous avons basculé vers ce compte.
